output.title: AWS order fan-out
output.description: An order API publishes SNS events to isolated fulfillment, archive and receipt queues, with scheduled reconciliation.

traffic.label: 290 orders: steady demand and a flash sale

action.text: SNS fans each order into isolated fulfillment, archive and receipt queues.
The flash sale peaks at 100 orders per second.
Fulfillment is throttled to one Lambda worker. The other queues remain independent.
Reserved concurrency is restored; fulfillment catches up.
